name: Collateral Value Creation Request V 01
definition: The CollateralValueCreationRequest message is sent by the instructing party to the executing party to request for the creation of a collateral value in the executing system collateral management reference data.||Usage: |It aims at instructing the creation of a new collateral value with corresponding details.|Processing and confirmation of the collateral value creation request message are provided via a collateral management status advice.
